data.gender_notes: Hara is used as a unisex name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The meaning of Hara is recorded in name-lists as “Mountain, high place”. This meaning has NOT been verified against a classical lexical or onomastic source, so it is published as an unverified candidate only. The record is flagged for manual source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Hara expresses “Mountain, high place”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hara total 19, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.

in_hebrew.name: חרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word חרה (charah), meaning mountainous, rocky, rough. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Ἅρα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Ἅρα (Hara) has a different meaning from the Hebrew origin. It is derived from the Greek word ἁγελία (hagelia), meaning harvest. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Hara
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Hara is derived from the Latin word harus, meaning rock, mountain, or rough. This name is not found in the Bible.
